name: Chiaki Ryousuke
source: A classmate of Megumu who's bullying him. He sneaks into school at night to look for his missing friends and takes Megumu with him. He's rather superstitious and believes that they were kidnapped by the Midnight Friend, one of the seven mysteries of their middle school.
